The '''GSS-4Y Jurgoran''' was a [[Gunship/Legends|gunship]] model produced by [[SoroSuub Corporation/Legends|SoroSuub Corporation]] for the [[Imperial Navy (Sith Empire)|Navy]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], which made use of the Jurgoran during [[Galactic War]] with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].
